evidence.summary: Retrieved DOT’s October 15 postponement, September rule, refund guidance and dashboard. The official notice supports the February 1, 2027 effective date and January flight-reporting period. Preserved WABC and Yahoo extracts document historical conflicting coverage; their live fetches failed.
evidence.limits: Partial automated documentary check, not human review or a full fact-check. No individual itinerary, carrier denial, reimbursement entitlement or current carrier-specific plan was adjudicated. Dashboard tables were not fully rendered by the fetch. Historical WABC wording was not reconfirmed as unchanged.
